mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to potential monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, which in turn could lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which may lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real GDP (GDPC1) above 3% quarter-over-quarter signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 QoQ > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a weakening supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 70% of instances where INDPRO MoM < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% year-over-year, it signals a potential monetary policy misalignment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which may lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 45% of instances where PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.5 million units signals increased demand in the housing market, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1.5 million.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% month-over-month signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 65% of instances where RSAFS MoM < -5%.
